He is always on the lookout for possible fellow performers, asking both Ragna and Carl to join, being very persistent to have the latter do so. His subordinates greatly revere him and he in turn treats them fairly, going so far as to treat them to a surprise vacation in the 7th Hierarchical City of Kazamotsu. He often address any individual he meets as "my dear". Despite his heavily female appearance, Amane's personality is fairly masculine.
